description: Source code for an OpenAI-compatible AI client, providing methods for summarization, quiz generation, and simple explanations, utilizing environment-configured API base and key.

classes.name: OpenAICompatibleClient
classes.description: A class providing methods to interact with OpenAI API for summarization, quiz creation, and explanations.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Constructs HTTP headers including authorization if API key is available.

methods.name: postChat
methods.description: Sends a chat request to the OpenAI API and returns the content of the first choice.

methods.name: summarize
methods.description: Generates a summary of provided text or content ID.

methods.name: generateQuiz
methods.description: Creates a quiz with Q&A pairs based on provided text or content ID, with fallback parsing.

methods.name: explainELI5
methods.description: Provides a simple explanation of content, as if explaining to a 5-year-old.
